author: Melissa R.
title: Green Giant privacy row looks incredible
body: We had 14 Green Giant Arborvitae installed along our back fence line and the crew was fast, careful with our sprinkler heads, and the plants were noticeably healthier than what we saw at the big box store. A year later every single one has thrived.

author: David T.
title: Knew exactly what would survive our clay soil
body: I told them about our drainage issues and they steered me toward Oakleaf Hydrangea and Beautyberry instead of the azaleas I originally wanted. Everything is thriving two seasons in. Appreciated the honest advice over an upsell.

author: Angela P.
title: Great selection, delivery ran a little late
body: Plant quality was excellent and the Encore Azaleas are blooming beautifully. Delivery was about a day later than the original window, but they called ahead to let us know and the plants were still in great shape.

author: Chris H.
title: Fig and blueberry order came in perfect
body: Ordered two Brown Turkey Figs and four Brightwell Blueberries for a small backyard orchard. Everything arrived well-rooted and healthy, and the planting tips card they included made spacing and soil prep simple.

author: Rachel M.
title: Best nursery in Gwinnett County, hands down
body: We've used BB Blossoms for three separate projects now — a privacy screen, a foundation planting refresh, and a small fruit orchard. Consistent quality every time, and their installation crew actually knows what they're doing.

author: Tom W.
title: Good value on Japanese Maples
body: Compared prices with two other local nurseries and BB Blossoms had healthier-looking Bloodgood Japanese Maples for less. Only reason for 4 stars instead of 5 is I wish they had a wider size range in stock.
